property.name: Greens Storage Valley Center
property.address: 28407 Lizard Rocks Rd, Valley Center, CA 92082

buildings.name: Building A
buildings.note: Building A: 28 10x10 units on two interior hallways (four rows of seven), entered from the south end. Traced from the Feb 2023 Building A key map and the Jun 2024 customer map.

buildings.name: Building B
buildings.note: Two-story climate-controlled building (county permit STP-03-026W1, 36,724 sq ft). Level 1: B001-B169 plus the 23 split halves (B095A..B131A), drive-up rows on both long walls and two interior hallways; level 2: B201-B350. Traced from the Feb 2023 Building B level 1 and level 2 floor plans (CAD). Level 2 is about 66 ft wide against level 1's 77 ft, set back on the west side over the 10x15 drive-up row.

buildings.name: Building C1
buildings.note: Long single row on the east property line: C001-C043 10x20 drive-ups facing west toward Building B, C044 at the south end. Traced from the Jun 2024 customer map.

buildings.name: Building C2
buildings.note: South row: C053-C071 12x35 drive-ups facing north, with the C045-C052 corner block at its east end. Traced from the Jun 2024 customer map.

buildings.name: Building D
buildings.note: D001-D006 12x50 drive-throughs at the east end, then D007-D018 (doors north) back to back with D019-D030 (doors south), all 12x25. Traced from the Jun 2024 customer map.

buildings.name: Building E1
buildings.note: Narrow row west of Building B: E001-E025, doors facing east toward B. Traced from the Jun 2024 customer map.

buildings.name: Building E2
buildings.note: E026-E038 12x35 drive-ups (E026 and E038 12x25) facing south toward Building D. Traced from the Jun 2024 customer map.

buildings.name: Building F
buildings.note: Southwest building: 43 units in four rows on one center hallway, the outer rows open to the outside. Traced from the Feb 2023 Building F key map and the Jun 2024 customer map.

buildings.name: Office
buildings.note: Office at the gate with the 279 rental mailboxes (M001-M279). Mailbox positions are not on any plan, so they are laid out schematically.
